title: Same-Day and Next-Day Dispatch Rates on TimeBank Travel
content:
**Travel dispatch lead schedule.** On TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours, the travel hours of an onsite date whose trip ticket, the ticket the trip is booked to, was opened that same day are multiplied by 1.25, a same-day dispatch; those of a date whose trip ticket was opened the day before, by 1.15, a next-day dispatch; those of any other date, by 1.

The opening of the ticket is the opened milestone of that ticket in the client's ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history, compared by calendar date, US Eastern, with the onsite date.

| Trip ticket opened | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| on the onsite date | 1.25 |
| on the day before the onsite date | 1.15 |
| two or more days before, or no opening on record | 1 |

Hypothetical cases for an onsite date of 14 October with 0.50 travel hours: a ticket opened at 07:40 on 14 October gives 0.625, that is 0.63 hours after rounding; one opened at 22:10 on 13 October gives 0.575, that is 0.58 hours; one opened on 11 October gives 0.50 hours.
